axes.model_access: Its own music-generation model line (the 250+ styles narrative on record same day); no third-party model picking; you can upload audio/MIDI influence sources and build your own style models (the "Ultimate customizability" section on the official site, on record same day).
axes.runtime: Web product (aiva.ai) + desktop app (the Download entry in the site navigation is on record); generation runs on AIVA's cloud; the export surface is pitched as "any file format" (MP3/MIDI named on the pricing page).
axes.local_files: Downloaded exported projects/audio are yours locally; generation and the track library live on AIVA's side; no locally-held model surface declared by the vendor was found.
axes.background: Generation returns instantly per the narrative ("in seconds"); long-task queueing/resume details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: Editing surface on record ("Edit your generated tracks", MIDI export feeding DAW workflows); no MCP/API support verified in official statements.
axes.context: Works are organized in the account's track library; no official statement verified for cross-session memory (say unknown when unknown).
axes.permissions: Account system (free + subscription; the €0 free tier on record same day); tier-split monetization rights are the core difference — the free tier keeps copyright with AIVA Limited and allows monetization only on YouTube/Twitch/TikTok/Instagram (on record in the terms page same day).
axes.fit: Fits: full-song generation for non-DAW users, MIDI-editable output feeding a DAW, full copyright under Pro for commercial scoring. Not a fit: a filed direct-mainland entry, picking third-party models, running models locally, free-tier monetization beyond four platforms.
